name: Magna Powertrain
old_description: Magna is the preferred global manufacturer of mechanical components for eDrive systems when precision, experience, and high volumes are required.
about:
Magna Powertrain is the powertrain operating unit of Magna International, headquartered at 1870 Technology Drive in Troy, Michigan. The group is led by President Diba Ilunga and serves as a long-standing premier supplier to the global automotive industry.

The unit provides end-to-end powertrain solutions encompassing design, development, testing, and manufacturing. Its portfolio spans battery-electric (BEV) powertrains, hybrid systems (including 48V mild hybrid, HEV, and PHEV), and a range of modules and components such as transmissions, all-wheel-drive and four-wheel-drive systems, disconnect systems, and common internal-combustion-engine modules. Magna Powertrain also operates a strategic joint venture with LG Electronics, LG Magna, focused on e-mobility components.

Customers are global automotive OEMs producing passenger cars and light commercial vehicles. The group’s hardware and software innovations target CO2 reduction, efficiency, safety, comfort, and driving dynamics across ICE, hybrid, and BEV platforms.

Magna Powertrain emphasizes sustainability across its value chain, reporting 100 percent renewable electricity at all European EMAS-registered sites, a 97 percent recyclability rate for its transmissions, and net-zero roadmaps finalized across its EMAS sites. The joint venture with LG Electronics aims to accelerate growth in the rapidly changing EV component market.
